termos.metaDescription: Terms of Use and General Conditions for the BipFix platform, for customers, partner repair shops and parts stores.
termos.pageTitle: Terms of Use and General Conditions
termos.title1: 1. Who we are and what BipFix is
termos.body1a: BipFix is a digital intermediation platform that connects (i) drivers and vehicle owners ("Customers") who need auto repair services with (ii) auto repair shops ("Repair Shops") and (iii) auto parts stores ("Stores"), collectively "Partners". By creating an account or using BipFix in any way, you agree to these Terms of Use and to our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>.
termos.body1b: BipFix does not provide auto repair services, does not sell parts, and is not a party to the contract entered into between a Customer and a Partner. Our role is that of a technology intermediary: we enable contact, quote comparison, communication and service tracking. The consumer relationship for the service performed (repair, part sold, timeline, quality, warranty) is established directly between the Customer and the Partner, who are responsible for their own conduct under the consumer protection law applicable in the Customer's country of residence.
termos.body2: You must provide true, complete and up-to-date information when registering (name, tax ID, address, contact details). Repair Shops and Stores represent that they hold the registrations, licenses and permits required for their activity. BipFix may request supporting documents and refuse or suspend registrations containing false, incomplete or unverifiable data.
termos.body3: Use of the platform by Customers is, and will remain, free of charge: requesting quotes, comparing proposals, tracking service progress and rating Partners come at no cost.
termos.body4a: Currently, for certain Partners (including those who join during the platform's initial phase), no commission or subscription fee is charged for using BipFix. BipFix reserves the right to introduce, in the future, a commission on brokered services, a subscription fee, or both.
termos.body4b: Should BipFix decide to introduce or change any charges, it will notify affected Partners at least 30 (thirty) days in advance of any amount actually being charged, by email and/or notice within the platform, stating the new pricing model, the applicable percentage or amount, and the date the charge takes effect. A Partner who does not agree with the new terms may close their account before the charge takes effect, without any penalty.
termos.title5: 5. Partner conduct and use of the platform
termos.intro5: By joining as a partner Repair Shop or Store, you agree to:
termos.list5_1: Provide truthful information about prices, timelines, availability and specialties;
termos.list5_2: Honor the quotes and timelines communicated to the Customer within the platform;
termos.list5_3: Not induce the Customer to complete the negotiation or payment outside the platform for the purpose of evading an applicable commission, when such commission is in effect and has been communicated under Clause 4;
termos.list5_4: Not manipulate, purchase, trade, or otherwise commit fraud with reviews and reputation scores;
termos.list5_5: Treat Customers and other Partners with respect, without discrimination, harassment, coercion, or unfair or deceptive business practices;
termos.list5_6: Comply with the laws applicable to their activity, including consumer protection, labor, tax and environmental regulations.
termos.intro6: BipFix may warn, temporarily suspend, or permanently remove a Partner from the platform, in proportion to the severity of the conduct identified. In particular:
termos.sub6_1Title: 6.1 Violations that may result in a prior warning and a period to remedy
termos.body6_1: Minor or isolated violations (e.g., occasionally being slow to respond to requests, an outdated registration) will generally result in a notice and a reasonable period to correct the issue before any suspension.
termos.sub6_2Title: 6.2 Serious violations resulting in immediate removal, without prior notice
termos.body6_2: In the cases below, BipFix may suspend or terminate a Partner's access immediately and without prior notice, given the severity involved and the risk to trust across the entire platform ecosystem:
termos.list6_2_1: Fraud, evasion, or attempted evasion of the commission model in effect (e.g., directing Customers to close a deal outside the platform to avoid paying an applicable commission, use of fake accounts, reporting amounts different from those actually charged);
termos.list6_2_2: Repeated negative Customer reviews indicating a pattern of poor service, improper charges, failure to honor a quote, or unethical conduct;
termos.list6_2_3: Unfair, deceptive, or fraudulent practices, including but not limited to: false information about parts or services, charging an amount different from the quote without justification, discrimination against Customers, harassment, or misuse of Customer data obtained through the platform;
termos.list6_2_4: A determination by a competent authority or the finding of illegal activity.
termos.body6_2b: The severity of the conduct and the applicable measure (warning, temporary suspension, or permanent removal) are assessed by BipFix on a case-by-case basis. A removed Partner may request reconsideration in writing, providing clarifications, which BipFix will review.
termos.body7: Customers may rate the service provided after its completion. Reviews reflect the opinion of the person who wrote them and are displayed publicly on the Partner's profile. BipFix may remove reviews that are demonstrably false, offensive, or in violation of the law, but is not responsible for the content of Customers' legitimate opinions.
termos.intro8: Nothing in these Terms limits the rights guaranteed to Customers under the consumer protection law applicable in their country of residence (for example, Brazil's Consumer Protection Code for Customers in Brazil, or EU consumer protection law — including the statutory guarantee under the Consumer Sales and Guarantees Directive — for Customers in the European Union). Those rights generally include, among others:
termos.list8_1: The right to clear and adequate information about services and parts, prices, characteristics and risks;
termos.list8_2: A statutory warranty period to report apparent or easily identifiable defects in services and durable goods (such as auto repairs and parts), as set by the law applicable in the Customer's country, counted from delivery of the vehicle or product;
termos.list8_3: Supplier liability of the Repair Shop or Store for defects in the service performed or the part sold;
termos.list8_4: The prohibition of unfair or abusive commercial practices, such as tie-in sales, charging for unsolicited services, or misleading information;
termos.list8_5: A channel for complaints and dispute mediation between Customer and Partner, provided by BipFix as a courtesy, without prejudice to the Customer's right to contact the consumer protection agency of their country (for example, Procon and the consumidor.gov.br platform in Brazil) or the courts directly against the responsible Partner.
termos.body9: The processing of personal data carried out by BipFix follows the data protection law applicable to you (for example, the GDPR for Customers and Partners in the European Union, or Brazil's General Data Protection Law — LGPD — for those in Brazil) and is detailed in our <privacyLink>Privacy Policy</privacyLink>, which forms an integral part of these Terms.
termos.body10: The BipFix brand, its layout, source code and other elements of the platform are owned by BipFix or its licensors, and reproduction, reverse engineering or unauthorized use is prohibited. Content submitted by Customers and Partners (photos, descriptions, messages) remains owned by whoever submitted it, but you grant BipFix a license to display it on the platform to the extent necessary to operate the service.
termos.body11: BipFix makes efforts to verify Partner registrations and to mediate any conflicts, but does not guarantee the quality, legality, adequacy, or outcome of the service performed by Repair Shops or the part sold by Stores, for which the performing Partner is solely responsible under applicable consumer law. BipFix is also not responsible for temporary platform unavailability resulting from maintenance, third-party failures, or unforeseeable circumstances and force majeure events.
termos.body12: We may update these Terms to reflect platform improvements or legal changes. Material changes (including any change to the commission policy, which follows the specific rule in Clause 4) will be communicated with reasonable advance notice. Continued use of the platform after such notice constitutes acceptance of the new terms.
termos.body13: Disputes involving a Customer are governed by, and the courts of, the Customer's country of residence, to the extent mandatory consumer protection law so requires (for Customers in Brazil, this means Brazilian law and the courts of the Customer's place of residence, as permitted under art. 101, I of the Consumer Protection Code). For disputes between Partners and BipFix arising exclusively from the intermediation business relationship, and where not otherwise required by mandatory local law, the courts of the District of São Paulo/SP, Brazil are elected. Note: the governing-law provisions of this clause for markets outside Brazil are provisional pending review by local counsel, and do not override any mandatory consumer-protection rule of the Customer's country.
termos.body14: Questions about these Terms may be sent to <mailLink>support@bipfix.com</mailLink>.
termos.footerDisclaimer: This document is provided for informational purposes and reflects the operating rules of the BipFix platform. It was originally drafted for the Brazilian market; the generic, jurisdiction-neutral language used for other countries is a provisional draft, and full legal compliance in each country where BipFix operates requires review by a lawyer specializing in local consumer and data protection law before commercial release there.

privacidade.metaDescription: How BipFix collects, uses and protects the personal data of customers, partner repair shops and stores, in compliance with applicable data protection law (GDPR / LGPD).
privacidade.body1: This Privacy Policy describes how BipFix ("we") collects, uses, shares and protects the personal data of Customers, partner Repair Shops and Stores ("you"), in compliance with the data protection law applicable to you — for those in the European Union, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR); for those in Brazil, the General Data Protection Law (Law No. 13,709/2018 — LGPD) and the Brazilian Civil Rights Framework for the Internet (Law No. 12,965/2014).
privacidade.list2_1: Registration data: name, tax ID, email, phone number, address and, for Repair Shops/Stores, business and staff (employee) details;
privacidade.list2_2: Location data: address and geographic coordinates, used to match Customers with nearby Partners;
privacidade.list2_3: Vehicle data: make, model, year, license plate (when provided) and photos of the reported damage;
privacidade.list2_4: Usage data: quotes, messages exchanged on the platform, reviews, service history and parts orders;
privacidade.list2_5: Technical data: IP address, session identifiers and access logs, retained as required by applicable law (for example, the Brazilian Civil Rights Framework for the Internet, for those in Brazil);
privacidade.list2_6: Cookies and similar technologies: used to keep you authenticated and for aggregated site usage statistics.
privacidade.title3: 3. What we use your data for (purpose and legal basis)
privacidade.list3_1: Contract performance/service delivery: creating your account, connecting Customers with Partners, processing quotes and orders, enabling chat and notifications;
privacidade.list3_2: Compliance with a legal obligation: maintaining tax records and access logs;
privacidade.list3_3: Legitimate interest: fraud prevention, platform improvement, information security, and communications about updates to the service you already use;
privacidade.list3_4: Consent: when required, such as for marketing communications separate from the existing relationship — you may withdraw your consent at any time.
privacidade.title4: 4. Who we share your data with
privacidade.intro4: We share data strictly to the extent necessary for the platform to function:
privacidade.list4_1: Between the Customer and Partner involved in the same quote request or order, to enable service delivery (name, contact details, address where applicable, vehicle photos);
privacidade.list4_2: With technical infrastructure providers (hosting, database, transactional email/WhatsApp delivery), under contractual confidentiality and security obligations;
privacidade.list4_3: With public authorities, when required by law, court order, or regulatory request.
privacidade.body4: We do not sell personal data to third parties for advertising purposes.
privacidade.title5: 5. How long we keep your data
privacidade.body5: We keep your data for as long as your account is active, plus any additional period required to meet legal, tax and regulatory obligations (for example, internet application access logs are kept for a minimum of 6 months, as required by the Brazilian Civil Rights Framework for the Internet, for those in Brazil), or for the regular exercise of rights in administrative or judicial proceedings.
privacidade.title6: 6. Your rights as a data subject
privacidade.intro6: Under the data protection law applicable to you, you may request at any time:
privacidade.list6_1: Confirmation of whether processing is taking place and access to your data;
privacidade.list6_2: Correction of incomplete, inaccurate or outdated data;
privacidade.list6_3: Anonymization, blocking or deletion of unnecessary data, or data processed in violation of the law;
privacidade.list6_4: Portability of your data to another service provider;
privacidade.list6_5: Deletion of data processed on the basis of your consent;
privacidade.list6_6: Information on who we share your data with;
privacidade.body6: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at <mailLink>privacy@bipfix.com</mailLink>. We will respond within the applicable legal timeframe.
privacidade.body7: We adopt technical and administrative measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access and accidental or unlawful destruction, loss, alteration, disclosure or dissemination, including authentication-based access control, per-account data isolation (database-level row-level security) and encryption in transit.
privacidade.body8: BipFix is not directed at individuals under 18 years of age and does not knowingly collect data from children or minors.
privacidade.body9: We may update this Policy from time to time. Material changes will be communicated by email or platform notice before they take effect.
privacidade.body10: For questions related to personal data protection, contact: <mailLink>privacy@bipfix.com</mailLink>.
privacidade.footerDisclaimer: This document is provided for informational purposes. It was originally drafted for the Brazilian market (LGPD); the generic, jurisdiction-neutral language used for other countries is a provisional draft, and full legal compliance in each country where BipFix operates (including GDPR compliance in the European Union) requires review by a lawyer specializing in local data protection law before commercial release there.

docsHome.metaDescription: Get answers about how to use the BipFix platform. Complete guides for drivers and repair shops.
docsHome.heroSubtitle: Everything you need to know to use the platform, whether you're a driver or a repair shop.
docsHome.clienteCardText: Learn how to create requests, compare quotes, schedule services and track your vehicle's repair in real time.
docsHome.oficinaCardText: Find out how to register your shop, receive requests, send quotes, manage your schedule and build your reputation.
docsHome.contactText: Our team is ready to help. Get in touch through any of the channels below.

docsLayout.footerContactText: Still have questions? Contact us by email at <mailLink>support@bipfix.com</mailLink>.

docsCliente.pageSubtitle: Everything you need to know to find the best repair shop, compare quotes and track your vehicle's repair.
docsCliente.s1Intro: Creating your BipFix account is quick and free. Just follow these steps:

s1Steps.title: Go to the sign-up page
s1Steps.desc: Click 'I need a repair' on the homepage, or go directly to /cadastro.

s1Steps.title: Fill in your details
s1Steps.desc: Enter your full name, email, phone number and create a secure password.

s1Steps.title: Confirm your email
s1Steps.desc: You'll receive a confirmation email. Click the link to activate your account.

s1Steps.title: Add your vehicle
s1Steps.desc: Add the make, model, year and license plate of your vehicle. You can add more than one.

docsCliente.s2Intro: A request is the quote request you send to repair shops. The process has 5 simple steps:

s2Steps.title: Select your vehicle
s2Steps.desc: Choose which of your registered vehicles needs a repair.

s2Steps.title: Type of service
s2Steps.desc: Select the service category: bodywork, paint, mechanical, electrical, glass and more.

s2Steps.title: Photos and description
s2Steps.desc: Take photos of the damage or issue and add a detailed description. The more information you give, the better the quote will be.

s2Steps.title: Location
s2Steps.desc: Confirm your location so nearby repair shops receive your request. You can use GPS or type in your address.

s2Steps.title: Review and send
s2Steps.desc: Review all the information and send it. Nearby repair shops will be notified and start preparing quotes.

docsCliente.s3Intro: When repair shops send quotes, you can easily compare them. Each quote shows the total price, estimated timeline, itemized details and the shop's rating.

s3Badges.name: Quality Badge
s3Badges.desc: Repair shops with an average rating above 4.5 stars and more than 10 completed services.

s3Badges.name: Fast Response
s3Badges.desc: Repair shops that responded to your request in under 1 hour.

s3Badges.name: Price Adjustment
s3Badges.desc: Indicates the repair shop is open to negotiating the quote amount.

docsCliente.s3Outro: Use the filters to sort by price, timeline or rating. Click on each quote to see the full breakdown of items and services.
docsCliente.s4Intro: After comparing quotes, choose the one that best fits your needs:

s4Steps.title: Accept the quote
s4Steps.desc: Click 'Accept quote' on the one you've chosen. The repair shop will be notified right away.

s4Steps.title: Choose a date
s4Steps.desc: The repair shop makes time slots available on its schedule. Pick the day and time that works best for you.

s4Steps.title: Confirmation
s4Steps.desc: Once confirmed, you'll receive the appointment details by email and on the platform, including the shop's address.

docsCliente.s5Intro: After dropping off your vehicle at the repair shop, you can follow every stage of the repair through the platform:

s5Items.label: Check-in
s5Items.desc: When the vehicle arrives at the shop, the team logs its arrival.

s5Items.label: In progress
s5Items.desc: The repair shop updates the status as it moves through each stage of the service.

s5Items.label: Detailed stages
s5Items.desc: You can see the progress: disassembly, repair, painting, reassembly, quality check.

s5Items.label: Ready for pickup
s5Items.desc: Once the service is complete, you get a notification to pick up your vehicle.

s5Items.label: Check-out
s5Items.desc: The repair shop logs the vehicle's departure and marks the service as finished.

docsCliente.s5Outro: Access the tracking page any time from the "My Services" menu in your dashboard.
docsCliente.s6Intro: Once the service is finished, you can rate the repair shop to help other drivers:

s6Steps.title: Rate 1 to 5 stars
s6Steps.desc: Rate the overall quality of the service provided.

s6Steps.title: Add a comment
s6Steps.desc: Write a comment describing your experience. Be honest and specific.

s6Steps.title: Publication
s6Steps.desc: Your review will appear on the repair shop's public profile, helping other drivers decide.

docsCliente.s6Note: Your review really matters. It helps keep the platform's quality high and recognizes the best repair shops.
docsCliente.s7Intro: BipFix has a special flow for emergency situations:

s7Steps.title: Tap the emergency button
s7Steps.desc: On the homepage or in your dashboard, tap the red 'I Just Crashed' button.

s7Steps.title: Log the incident
s7Steps.desc: Take photos of the damage right away. You can also register the other vehicle involved, including its license plate and photos.

s7Steps.title: Automatic location
s7Steps.desc: The system uses your GPS to find the nearest repair shops to the accident location.

s7Steps.title: Fast quotes
s7Steps.desc: Nearby repair shops receive your request as a priority and send quotes within minutes.

docsCliente.s7Warning: If anyone is injured, call emergency services (112) first. Your safety comes first.

docsClienteLayout.metaDescription: Learn how to use BipFix to request repairs, compare quotes from repair shops and track your vehicle's repair in real time.

docsOficina.pageSubtitle: Learn how to use all of BipFix's tools to attract customers, manage services and grow your business.
docsOficina.s1Title: 1. How to register your repair shop
docsOficina.s1Intro: Registering your repair shop on BipFix is simple and takes just a few minutes:

s1Steps.title: Create your account
s1Steps.desc: Go to /cadastro and select 'I'm a repair shop'. Fill in the details of the person in charge: name, email and password.

s1Steps.title: Repair shop details
s1Steps.desc: Enter your business tax ID, legal name, trade name, phone number and full address.

s1Steps.title: Specialties
s1Steps.desc: Select the types of service your shop offers: bodywork, paint, mechanical, electrical, glass, and more.

s1Steps.title: Service radius
s1Steps.desc: Set the distance (in km) within which your shop accepts requests. You can adjust it later.

s1Steps.title: Complete profile
s1Steps.desc: Add photos of the shop, a description, business hours and accepted payment methods. A complete profile attracts more customers.

docsOficina.s2Intro: BipFix automatically sends requests to repair shops that match the customer's criteria:

s2Items.label: Proximity
s2Items.desc: The customer is within the service radius you set.

s2Items.label: Specialty
s2Items.desc: The requested service type matches your shop's specialties.

s2Items.label: Availability
s2Items.desc: Your shop is active on the platform with an open schedule.

docsOficina.s2Body: You'll receive notifications on your dashboard and by email. Each request includes: photos of the damage, a description of the issue, vehicle type and the customer's location.
docsOficina.s2Tip: Tip: keep your profile up to date and your specialties accurate to receive the most relevant requests.
docsOficina.s3Intro: To send a competitive, detailed quote:

s3Steps.title: Review the request
s3Steps.desc: Look at the customer's photos and description. If you need more information, you can send a message.

s3Steps.title: Add items to the quote
s3Steps.desc: List each service and part separately with a description, quantity and unit price. The more detailed it is, the more confidence the customer will have.

s3Steps.title: Estimated timeline
s3Steps.desc: State how many business days the service will take.

s3Steps.title: Schedule availability
s3Steps.desc: Select the available time slots for the customer to schedule the vehicle drop-off.

s3Steps.title: Send the quote
s3Steps.desc: Review and send. The customer will be notified and can compare it with other quotes.

docsOficina.s3Tip: Detailed quotes with fair prices are up to 3x more likely to be accepted.
docsOficina.s4Intro: The schedule dashboard lets you organize all of your shop's services:

s4Items.label: Check-in
s4Items.desc: Log the vehicle's arrival at the shop. The customer is notified automatically.

s4Items.label: Internal jobs
s4Items.desc: Create internal jobs (ones that didn't come through BipFix) to keep your schedule organized.

s4Items.label: Assignment
s4Items.desc: Assign each vehicle to a specific mechanic on your team.

s4Items.label: Check-out
s4Items.desc: When the service is finished and the vehicle picked up, log its departure.

docsOficina.s4Outro: The calendar view shows all scheduled, in-progress and completed services in one place.
docsOficina.s5Intro: Manage your team members directly through the platform:

s5Steps.title: Add staff
s5Steps.desc: Add mechanics and other staff by entering their name, email and role (mechanic, front desk, manager).

s5Steps.title: First login
s5Steps.desc: The staff member receives an email with temporary credentials and must set a new password on their first login.

s5Steps.title: Assign vehicles
s5Steps.desc: Assign vehicles being serviced to specific mechanics. Each mechanic only sees the vehicles assigned to them.

s5Steps.title: Role-based permissions
s5Steps.desc: Mechanics have limited access (assigned vehicles only). Managers and admins have full access to the dashboard.

docsOficina.s6Intro: Keep the customer informed about the repair's progress:

s6Items.label: Status updates
s6Items.desc: Change the service status: received, in progress, awaiting parts, completed.

s6Items.label: Detailed stages
s6Items.desc: Log each stage: disassembly, structural repair, prep, painting, reassembly, quality check.

s6Items.label: Automatic notifications
s6Items.desc: Every status change generates a notification for the customer.

s6Items.label: Progress photos
s6Items.desc: Send photos of each stage so the customer can follow along visually.

docsOficina.s6Note: Repair shops that update the status frequently get higher ratings and build more customer loyalty.
docsOficina.s7Intro: Your reputation on the platform is built through customer reviews:

s7Items.label: 1 to 5 star rating
s7Items.desc: The average appears on your public profile and in search results.

s7Items.label: Comments
s7Items.desc: Customers can leave detailed comments about their experience.

s7Items.label: Quality Badge
s7Items.desc: Repair shops with an average above 4.5 and more than 10 services receive the green quality badge.

s7Items.label: Fast Response
s7Items.desc: Responding to quote requests in under 1 hour earns the blue badge.

docsOficina.s7Outro: You can reply publicly to reviews, showing professionalism and attention to your customers.
docsOficina.s8Intro: BipFix charges a commission on services carried out through the platform. Here's how it works:

s8Items.label: How it's charged
s8Items.desc: The commission is calculated on the total value of the quote accepted by the customer.

s8Items.label: Transparency
s8Items.desc: The commission percentage is shown before the quote is sent, with no surprises.

s8Items.label: Billing
s8Items.desc: Charges are made monthly, with a detailed report of all services.

s8ReduceList: Keep an average rating above 4.5 stars.
Respond to requests quickly (in under 1 hour).
Complete services within the estimated timeline.
Keep your profile complete and up to date.
docsOficina.s8Note: Repair shops with excellent performance can get up to a 30% reduction in their commission rate.
